authors.name: Sukant Ratnakar
authors.bio: Sukant Ratnakar is an author, storyteller, certified management consultant, and business strategist with over two decades of experience in crafting business opportunities around the world. As Founder & CEO of Quantraz Inc., he is a Business Storyteller and Legacy Builder who helps business leaders and owners answer the question 'Why should I choose you?' He is a silver medalist from IIIE Mumbai and holds an executive MBA in International Management from Edinburgh Business School (Heriot-Watt University).

authors.name: Tanya Eklund
authors.bio: Tanya Eklund is a Calgary-based children's book author whose debut book 'I'm More Than Just a Warthog' tackles bullying with heart, courage, and kindness—encouraging kids to embrace their true selves. The book became a bestseller at Owls Nest Books in Calgary. Set in the lush Mombo Jungle, it tells the tale of Wanda, a shy warthog who faces teasing and self-doubt. Tanya is also a successful real estate professional - Founder & Managing Partner of The Tanya Eklund Group at RE/MAX First, recognized as a Top Luxury Agent and #1 Team in RE/MAX Central Calgary.
credentials: Founder & Managing Partner, The Tanya Eklund Group
authors.bookTitle: I'm More Than Just a Warthog

authors.name: Anshu Bhatnagar
authors.bio: Anshu Bhatnagar is the Creative Head & Founder of Neoterics (formerly DesignMill), a design agency and brand consultant serving over 290+ clients in India and abroad for over 16 years. He has had an exuberant journey in the Advertising industry, honing skills in Ad Agencies, Graphic studios, Publication, Digital Agencies, and Client-side management over 2 decades. A Fine Art Graduate and Post Graduate in Commercial Graphic Arts from Shankars Academy of Arts, he has evolved with graphic designing alongside Macintosh & Adobe since their early days in India. He is best known for his visual identity sense, creative photography, strategic brand promotion plans, and designing prestigious coffee table books for government and corporate clients.
credentials: Creative Head & Founder, Neoterics Design Agency
Post Graduate in Commercial Graphic Arts, Shankars Academy of Arts
Coffee Table Book Designer (Chief Ministers, Tourism departments)

authors.name: Dr Hans Erlings
authors.bio: Dr Hans Erlings is a Sage at Quantraz, serving as a source of inspiration and guiding the organization with wisdom, judgment, and experience. He is known for his work on 'Adapting to Change' and contributions to the Quantraz Shallots collection. His expertise includes workshops on OmniMeta Mindfulness, Understanding Tinergy, and Change Anesthesiology—each designed to boost focus, energy, and adaptability.
credentials: Experience at Galfar Engineering & Contracting SAOG

authors.name: Jamie Clarke
authors.bio: Jamie Clarke (born 1968) is a Canadian mountaineer, filmmaker, author, documentarian, entrepreneur, and public speaker. He has summited Mt. Everest twice (1997 and 2010), climbed the Seven Summits, and is one of the few westerners who have crossed The Empty Quarter of Arabia on camels (1,000 miles). As a seasoned expedition leader and motivational speaker, he shares lessons learned from journeys of contrast, courage, and endurance—from the top of Everest to the deserts of Arabia, from Mongolia to The Andes. He empowers teams and individuals to pursue courageous lives at home and at work. Jamie is also an Associate Adjunct Professor at the University of Calgary Haskayne School of Business and co-founder/CEO of LiveOutThere.com.
credentials: Crossed The Empty Quarter of Arabia on camels
Associate Adjunct Professor, University of Calgary Haskayne School of Business

authors.name: Wendy Quan
authors.bio: Wendy Quan is the founder of The Calm Monkey and the pioneer in workplace mindfulness facilitator training and certification. She is the featured expert for Mindfulness for the Workplace course from The Great Courses and Audible. Through her cancer diagnosis in 2010, she found her passion for mindfulness and meditation for her own well-being and to help others. Her previous career was in corporate management specializing in Human Resources, Change Management, and Information Technology. She is a certified organizational change manager since 2007 and published the award-winning paper 'Meditation - a Powerful Change Management Tool' with the Association of Change Management Professionals (ACMP). Over 450 mindfulness facilitators trained worldwide through her flagship certification program.
credentials: Pioneer in Workplace Mindfulness Facilitator Training & Certification
Featured Expert on The Great Courses and Audible
UC Berkeley Greater Good Science Center instructor (2015)
Partnered with Mindful Society Global Institute
BC Chartered Professionals in Human Resources partner

authors.name: Nitin Rakesh
authors.bio: Nitin Rakesh is an Indian-American businessman, author, and philanthropist, currently serving as Chief Executive Officer and Managing Director of Mphasis, a leading applied technology services company. Under his leadership, Mphasis has become known for embracing digital transformation and AI innovation. He co-authored 'Transformation in Times of Crisis: Eight Principles for Creating Opportunities and Value in the Post-Pandemic World' (December 2020) with Jerry Wind. He takes pride in leading an applied tech company 'where it's cool to be a geek,' driving enterprises to embrace digital transformation.

authors.name: Yoram (Jerry) Wind
authors.bio: Yoram (Jerry) Wind is the Lauder Professor Emeritus and Professor of Marketing at The Wharton School, University of Pennsylvania, where he joined in 1967 with a doctorate from Stanford. He founded the Wharton 'Think Tank' – The SEI Center for Advanced Studies in Management and directed it for three decades. Among his innovations at Wharton: the Wharton Executive MBA, the Lauder Institute, the new MBA curriculum of 1990, The Wharton Fellows, and Wharton School Publishing. He has authored, co-authored, or edited 30 books and over 300 articles, including 'Transformation in Times of Crisis' (2020) with Nitin Rakesh, 'Beyond Advertising' (2016), and 'The Network Imperative' (2016). He received all four major marketing awards and was inducted into the Marketing Hall of Fame in 2017.
credentials: Lauder Professor Emeritus, The Wharton School
Professor of Marketing, University of Pennsylvania
Founder, SEI Center for Advanced Studies in Management
Recipient of all four major marketing awards
